defect: In the pic0 and pic1 LoadPNG failure branches the change deletes and nulls info->iconTexture instead of pic0Texture/pic1Texture (copy-paste), leaking the failed pic texture, leaving it in use, and destroying a valid icon.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these copy-pasted lines that the change added.

defect: sceKernelDeleteHeap calls kernelObjects.Destroy<FPL>(heap->uid), which already deletes the HeapInformation object, and then deletes heap again (double free).
reason: The fix removes the extra 'delete heap' added by this change; seeing the double free needs KernelObjectPool::Destroy in sceKernel.h.

defect: The new SCREENSHOT_RENDER path (savestate thumbnails) yields 32-bit 8888 framebuffers, but the Qt branch still wraps every buffer as QImage::Format_RGB888, producing garbled Qt screenshots.
reason: Before the change Qt only saved RGB888 display buffers; the change routed 8888 render buffers into the RGB888-only Qt code (the non-Qt branch of the same diff handles 8888), and the fix changes that Qt format.

defect: The main loop now calls the blocking ThreadFrame(true) until the state is DISABLED and the StopThread call in EmuThreadFunc was removed, so once the emu thread quits the main thread waits forever (OpenGL exit hang).
reason: The fix breaks out of that loop when the emu thread state is QUIT_REQUESTED or STOPPED; the hang needs the ThreadFrame(waitIfEmpty) semantics from the GL render manager.

defect: entry.fileName is a const char*, so 'entry.fileName == "jpn0.pgf"' compares pointers rather than strings and the jpn0 metrics hack only works by chance of literal pooling.
reason: The fix wraps the operand in std::string on the very line the change added.

defect: enableAlphaTest is computed from gstate.alphaBlendEnable instead of alphaTestEnable in both ComputeFragmentShaderID and GenerateFragmentShader, so alpha test is dropped or applied depending on blending.
reason: The removed line used alphaTestEnable, and the fix restores it in the two lines the change introduced.

defect: ToggleSwapAxes now takes lock_guard on mutex_, but it is called from the onVKey_ handler (EmuScreen, VIRTKEY_AXIS_SWAP) while UpdatePSPState already holds mutex_, so the non-recursive mutex is locked twice (deadlock).
reason: The fix removes the lock this change added; the double lock is visible only from the caller in UI/EmuScreen.cpp.

defect: The new shader-depal path is always taken (even when sampling the current render target) and gstate_c.useShaderDepal / the depal texture are not reset in the other framebuffer paths, so stale shader-depal state breaks later draws (#10993).
reason: The fix, explicitly for a regression of the new depal code, resets the flag in the other branches and skips shader depal for the current render target.

defect: The added ERROR_LOG_REPORT_ONCE passes the char array offset for a %i conversion (format/argument mismatch, undefined behaviour and a garbage log value).
reason: The fix replaces the argument with clutBase and %d in the line the change wrote.

defect: The new condition clears the backbuffer whenever gpu->PresentedThisFrame() is false, which is always the case with skip-buffer-effects (non-buffered) rendering, wiping the frame the game drew directly to the backbuffer; viewport/scissor are also left unset.
reason: The fix adds the !skipBufferEffects guard and viewport/scissor reset to this condition; knowing that non-buffered mode never calls CopyToOutput needs PresentationCommon.

defect: The call was switched to BindFramebufferAsColorTexture(1, nullptr, ...), but the renamed function no longer maps a null framebuffer to currentRenderVfb_, so shader blending dereferences null and crashes.
reason: The same commit removed the null handling in FramebufferManagerGLES.cpp; the fix passes GetCurrentRenderVFB() on this changed line.

defect: The store title bar now uses itemFocusedStyle colours, which differ from the previously hardcoded 0xFFbd9939 (the theme's itemDownStyle), so the title bar looks like a focused item and has wrong theme colours.
reason: The fix switches both lines the change added to itemDownStyle; that the old colour matches itemDownStyle is in UI/Theme.cpp.

defect: The new ERROR_LOG in AllocMemoryBlock has four format specifiers (%s, %i, %08x, %08x) but no arguments, reading garbage varargs (undefined behaviour, possible crash on %s).
reason: The fix adds the missing arguments to the line the change added.

defect: convertYCbCrToABGR packs red at bit 16 and blue at bit 0 (ARGB) although the PSP output is ABGR, so sceJpegCsc swaps red and blue.
reason: The fix swaps r and b in the return expression of the function this change added (the JPEG_DEBUG mkdir part is unrelated debug code).

defect: The label key was changed to 'Force <=60 FPS (helps GoW)', whose '=' breaks the key=value i18n ini format, so the string cannot be translated.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this changed key with 'Force max 60 FPS'; that '=' breaks translation needs the ini-based i18n format.

defect: The constructor skips README entries when building the display list but keeps them in langs_, and OnCompleted indexes langs_ with the list selection, so the selected language can map to the wrong file.
reason: The fix keeps langs_ in step with the shown list, repairing the index mismatch in the code this change added.

defect: The new non-Windows __cpuidex saves ebx with push/pop on i386 instead of declaring it clobbered, so the compiler may address outputs through ebx (or a shifted esp) and cpuid corrupts the writes on i386.
reason: The fix removes the push/pop and declares ebx clobbered on i386 in __cpuidex, which this change introduced (later simplified by a1c280f with the same i386 approach).

defect: AddRecent now erases from recentIsos inside the iterator loop and keeps incrementing the invalidated iterator (the old code returned right after the erase), which is undefined behaviour and crashes.
reason: The fix assigns the result of erase back to the iterator in the loop this change wrote.

defect: CompileShaderToBytecode now calls Crash() whenever shader compilation fails, although callers handle an empty result, so a post shader that fails to translate crashes the app.
reason: The fix removes the Crash() line this change added.

defect: vsge/vslt are routed to Jit::Comp_VecDo3, whose VFPU3 switch masks the subop with '& 3', so on x86 they compile as vmin/vmax and give wrong results (#3117).
reason: The fix reverts these two table entries to Comp_Generic; the wrong decoding is in Core/MIPS/x86/CompVFPU.cpp.

defect: index is u32, so 'index >= 0' is always true and any unhandled menu command indexes availableShaders out of bounds.
reason: The fix adds the missing upper-bound check to the condition this change added.

defect: The new VPGATHERDD loads read 32 bits at texel byte offsets, which can read past the end of a CLUT4 texture placed at the end of VRAM and segfault.
reason: The fix guards the gather paths added by this change with id.overReadSafe.

defect: The fix changes the return value of the scePsmfQueryStreamOffset stub from 0 to 1 as a game-specific hack for Saint Seiya Omega.
reason: Both versions are explicit UNIMPL stubs and the fix tunes a hack value rather than repairing a defect of an implementation.

defect: The new bitwise colour test applies roundAndScaleTo8x4 (scale by 255) to u_alphacolorref.rgb, which already holds 0-255 values, so the reference is wrong and the colour test fails.
reason: The old code used u_alphacolorref directly as integers, and the fix packs it without rescaling in the line the change added.

defect: SnapGrid::Draw draws vLine/hLine while the UI context is in textured mode, so the grid lines render incorrectly (and the grid is added on top of the controls).
reason: The fix wraps the drawing in BeginNoTex/Flush/Begin and adds the grid first; the texture-mode requirement is in the UI draw context.

defect: The speed percentage now divides by g_Config.iDisplayRefreshRate (integer, default 60) instead of 59.94, so full speed shows about 99.9 percent.
reason: The fix subtracts 0.06 from the refresh rate in this changed line; the default value lives in Config.

defect: The new matchingSize expression has wrong precedence, so the height comparison applies only to the 480/512 case and equal-width buffers of different heights get a depth blit.
reason: The fix re-parenthesises the expression this change introduced.

defect: On a full icache clear InvalidateCacheAt skips InvalidateBlock and calls backend_->ClearAllBlocks(), wiping native code that may still be executing (the clear comes from a syscall), which crashes.
reason: The fix reverts this special case added by the change; the crash depends on how ClearAllBlocks and the riscv backend work.

defect: The rewritten code halves msg to MAX_MSGLEN but still advances msgPos by vsnprintf's would-be length, so any truncated message writes the newline and terminator past the buffer.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this arithmetic; the would-be-length pattern was older, but with the change's smaller buffer every truncated message now overflows.

defect: In this file the fix only corrects the debug assert mask (0xC003 to 0xC03) and comments out debug ERROR_LOG lines; the functional FPU load/store fix is in ArmCompFPU.cpp.
reason: The assert mask and debug logging do not change the emitted code, so no functional defect of this file is repaired.

defect: The change meant to replace backslashes with forward slashes but calls ReplaceAll(e.s, "//", "/"), so Windows paths keep their backslashes and recents still get duplicates.
reason: The commit message states the intent and the fix corrects the pattern in both lines the change added.

defect: The new slider colour selection keys the dragging colour on down_, which Clickable clears when the pointer leaves the bounds while dragging_ stays true, so the slider colour flips while dragging (#20617).
reason: The fix replaces down_ with dragging_ in the selection the change added; down_ semantics are in Clickable::Touch.

defect: The fix adjusts GameBrowser top-bar spacing and gives the path TextView weight 1 instead of the change's WRAP_CONTENT plus spacer layout.
reason: It partly reverts the change's layout but also edits older spacing, and the diff does not show what concrete layout problem was fixed.

defect: LoadAndPrecompile ignores fread results and looks up vsCache_[vsid]/fsCache_[fsid] with operator[], so a truncated or inconsistent cache file gives uninitialised IDs and null shaders dereferenced in vs->UseHWTransform().
reason: The fix checks each read and uses find() before linking, repairing the loader this change added.

defect: trigCallHelper passes &sinCosFunc, the address of the local parameter, instead of the function pointer, so the JIT calls into the stack and crashes.
reason: The fix drops the & in both calls of the helper this change added.
